title: CellEdgeR technical note
text: CellEdgeR builds Delaunay graphs spatial cell coordinates, counts label-based motifs, tests differential abundance edgeR using Chung-Lu-style volume offsets. default primary statistical model volume based. CellEdgeR tests two result sets: edges: edge motifs extracted top_edges(). motifs2: wedge triangle motifs extracted top_motifs2(). Node counts used internally exposure submotif values, nodes tested. Wedges triangles kept separate; merged TP_* triplet test.

title: CellEdgeR technical note
code: library(CellEdgeR)  samples_list <- make_demo_samples(n_cells = 2000, seed = 1) metadata_df <- data.frame(   condition = rep(c("ctrl", "treated"), each = length(samples_list) / 2),   row.names = names(samples_list) )  cellgraph <- build_cell_graphs(samples_list, n_cores = 2) cellgraph <- count_motifs_graphs(cellgraph, max_edge_len = 50, include_wedge = TRUE, n_cores = 2) cellgraph <- motif_edger(   cellgraph,   sample_df = metadata_df,   design_formula = "~ condition" )  top_edges(cellgraph, coef = "conditiontreated") top_motifs2(cellgraph, coef = "conditiontreated")

title: CellEdgeR technical note
text: sample, CellEdgeR builds Delaunay triangulation 2D coordinates treats unique edges candidate adjacency. Optional pruning max_edge_len removes long edges counting motifs. Motifs counted label: Nodes: N_<label>, used internally tested motif_edger(). Edges: E_<label1>_<label2>, unordered. Triangles: T_<label1>_<label2>_<label3>, unordered. Wedges: W_<center>_<leaf1>_<leaf2>, centered optional. Counts per sample, yielding motif--sample matrix layer.

title: CellEdgeR technical note
text: volume approach uses label-specific degree volumes represent much graph available label sample. label, volume sum degrees cells label. Let 2m twice number edges sample. Offsets log expected counts Chung-Lu-style graph preserved label volumes: Edges: log(vol_a) + log(vol_b) - log(2m), -log(2) correction -label unordered pairs. Triangles: log(vol_a) + log(vol_b) + log(vol_c) - 2 * log(2m), plus unordered-label multiplicity correction. Wedges: center exposure sum(degree * (degree - 1)) center label, leaf-label volumes, equal-leaf correction. offsets use small offset_pseudo avoid log(0).

title: CellEdgeR technical note
text: motif_edger() stacks edge, wedge, triangle counts fits single edgeR quasi-likelihood negative-binomial GLM volume offsets. design matrix comes design_formula can include multiple covariates: logFC interpreted differential motif rate correcting volume exposure. p-value model coefficient test, direct test raw counts normalized-count medians. fitting, CellEdgeR applies edgeR::filterByExpr() stacked edge/wedge/triangle count matrix. standard edgeR low-expression filter prevents motifs observed samples, including one-sample spikes, entering multiple-testing table. filtering summary stored cellgraph$edger$filter.
code: cellgraph <- motif_edger(   cellgraph,   sample_df = sample_df,   design_formula = "~ condition + batch" )  edges_tbl <- top_edges(cellgraph, coef = "conditiontreated") motifs2_tbl <- top_motifs2(cellgraph, coef = "conditiontreated")
